purpose: Complete final non-production cutover preparation: detailed RPC preflight, secret-safe injection validation, Core-observability evidence hierarchy, production control contract, final read-only precheck, Runbook V7, independent read-only reviews, and final readiness evidence.
allowed_operations: implement fail-closed project-local preflight logic and tests
perform local installed-source and process-command-line audits without retrieving credential values
create specified sanitized reports and independent-review files
run offline test suites and read-only local process inspection
prohibited_actions: start or restart the production Project Gateway
send a real Feishu message, attachment, image, or card
modify Binding, Agent, Cron, OAuth, model, OpenClaw core, production configuration, or PROJECT_STATUS.yaml
read, write, print, hash, report, or pass credential values on a command line
commit, push, tag, mark P0_READY, or enter P1
hard_gates: only authenticated RPC health can report RPC_READY
a missing or invalid token remains unready and never falls back
a Core consumer is known only from explicit target-specific evidence
a real production mode remains guarded in task 036
the final precheck is read-only and fail-closed
independent reviews are supporting analysis and never substitute for runtime proof
secrets: Only booleans, statuses, hashes, counts, timestamps, source paths, and redacted evidence classifications may be persisted.
